data.title: Learn to Build with an Agent
data.outcome: Delegate work with observable goals, control the scope of changes, and verify an Agent's work with evidence.
intentExamples: How do I get an Agent to help me write code?
AI keeps changing the wrong things
I don't know how to verify an Agent's work

stages.title: Describe the current behavior and desired result
stages.action: State what happens now, what should happen, and what must not change.
stages.evidence: The Agent can begin investigating without guessing at product intent.

lessons.title: Markdown
lessons.tagline: Write structured text with lightweight punctuation

lessons.title: Agent Loop
lessons.tagline: A runtime mechanism that repeatedly calls AI and tools, then uses check results to continue, pause, or stop

stages.title: Ask the Agent to inspect before changing anything
stages.action: Ask the Agent to support its reasoning with files, pages, or logs.
stages.evidence: The direction for changes is grounded in evidence from the current project.

lessons.title: Tool Calling
lessons.tagline: A model’s request for an application to run a named tool with parameters

lessons.title: ReAct
lessons.tagline: A task pattern where an agent decides, acts with a tool, observes the result, and decides again

stages.title: Provide only the context needed for the task
stages.action: Choose relevant files and recent actions, and remove unrelated history.
stages.evidence: The Agent can find key context, and the task boundary remains clear.

lessons.title: Context Window
lessons.tagline: The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request

lessons.title: Conversation History
lessons.tagline: Conversation history is the earlier messages a product saves and can include again when they matter to a new request

stages.title: Review what the Agent actually changed
stages.action: Review the diff and ask the Agent to explain key behavior changes.
stages.evidence: The changes match the request and do not overwrite unrelated work.

lessons.title: Diff
lessons.tagline: See exactly what changed between two states

lessons.title: Commit
lessons.tagline: Save one meaningful set of changes in the project history

stages.title: Verify the result yourself in the real page or flow
stages.action: Repeat the main flow using observable acceptance criteria.
stages.evidence: You can decide for yourself whether the task is complete instead of trusting a summary alone.

lessons.title: Structured Output
lessons.tagline: Model output returned in an agreed, machine-checkable shape

lessons.title: Result
lessons.tagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step
